name: order-line
title: Order line
description: A read-only order line: picture, name, option, quantity times unit price, line total and a per-line status, read out as one sentence.
docs: Amounts are in minor units. compareAtAmount draws a struck price, discount adds a line and takes its amount off the total. Put lines in a <ul>; use as="div" outside a list. Pass statusLabel to translate the chip.
